etymologies.etymologyHTML: Compound of screw +‎ driver.

definitions.definition: A hand tool or power tool which engages with the head of a screw and allows torque to be applied to turn the screw, thus driving it in or loosening it.
A cocktail made of vodka and orange juice.

quote.citation: 2018, Tayari Jones, An American Marriage, Oneworld Publications, page 154:
quote.text: Celestial asked for a screwdriver and the bartender poured a good four fingers of Smirnoff into a flimsy cup before opening a can of juice.
